summary: monthly_statement now sends exactly merchant_id, tz (canonical zone, offsets mapped to Etc/GMT), half-open from/to and BCP 47 locale, rounds decimals per currency digits (half up) and formats text per locale. The meridale-display page returned 403, so code placement, negative sign and the exact separators are unverified guesses; the rounding page (half up) and changelog (half to even) also contradict each other.
